landing_meta_tagline: One room for everything you keep track of
landing_meta_description: Loomkeep is your space to track movies, shows, anime, games, books and albums. Keep your discoveries, watchlist and progress in one place.
landing_hero_body: Shows, movies, anime, games, books and albums. Loomkeep keeps track of every session — the date, the episode, what's next — and shows you your whole collection at a glance.
landing_programme_body: You open the rooms that matter to you. The ones you don't enable disappear from navigation, search and stats. Tick yours below — the rest of the page adjusts.
landing_salle_video_detail: Tracking episode by episode, seasons and rewatches.
landing_salle_games_detail: To play, in progress, finished or dropped, with playtime.
landing_salle_books_detail: Page progress and a yearly reading goal.
landing_salle_music_detail: To listen or listened: an album is tracked as a whole.
landing_salle_podcasts_detail: Announced in settings, not built yet.
landing_salle_boardgames_detail: Announced in settings, not built yet.
landing_comparator_question: How many apps does it take to track all of that?
landing_comparator_empty_hint: Tick at least one room above.
landing_comparator_apps_plural: apps, just as many accounts, no overview
landing_comparator_apps_singular: app — and nothing for the rest of your collection
landing_comparator_loomkeep_body: One library, one stats page, one export. The same account for every room you've opened.
landing_comparator_unshipped_singular: announced in settings, not built yet.
landing_comparator_unshipped_plural: announced in settings, not built yet.
landing_comparator_toggle_show: See the detail, service by service
landing_comparator_toggle_hide: Hide the detail, service by service
landing_comparator_detail_note: What each service covers, for the selection you just made. Partial coverage, self-hosted-only services (shield icon) and TV Time (shut down) don't count in the total above — signing up, running your own server and a service that no longer exists aren't the same kind of ask.
landing_comparator_loomkeep_row_note: Four rooms open, two announced. No subscription, no server to manage if you don't want one — and if you do, the
landing_rival_trakt_note: Shows, movies and anime. Since 2025 the free tier is capped at two lists of 100 titles.
landing_rival_simkl_note: Unlimited free tracking; its real strength is auto-checkoff from Netflix, Crunchyroll or Hulu.
landing_rival_tvtime_note: Acquired then shut down by its parent company, which pivoted to AI. 26 million accounts lost overnight — the clearest argument yet for an export that actually works.
landing_rival_letterboxd_note: The reference for film. No shows, no anime.
landing_rival_serializd_note: Letterboxd's counterpart for shows. No feature behind a subscription.
landing_rival_backloggd_note: Video games only, geared toward reviews and ratings.
landing_rival_hltb_note: Good for gauging how long a game takes before buying it, not for keeping a library.
landing_rival_goodreads_note: Owned by Amazon. Your reads feed their recommendations.
landing_rival_storygraph_note: Books only, but polished and independent.
landing_rival_babelio_note: Books, with an active French-speaking community and ads.
landing_rival_bookwyrm_note: Books, federated, self-hostable and completely ad-free — the same philosophy, one domain.
landing_rival_lastfm_note: Automatic scrobbling of what you listen to, not a library you curate yourself.
landing_rival_rym_note: Ratings and lists, a very thorough catalog.
landing_rival_discogs_note: Built for vinyl and the resale market, not for listening tracking.
landing_rival_antennapod_note: Free podcast player that keeps your progress per episode.
landing_rival_bgg_note: The reference database, plus play logging.
landing_rival_bgstats_note: Play tracking that syncs with BoardGameGeek. No subscription.
landing_rival_ryot_price: unstable demo, paid Pro even self-hosted
landing_rival_ryot_note: The closest rival in ambition: video, games, books, music and podcasts in one self-hosted tool. But it has no ready-to-use free instance — only a demo that gets randomly wiped — and sharing or recommendations stay paid even on your own server.
landing_import_title: Coming from elsewhere? Bring your history along.
landing_import_body: Nothing more discouraging than retyping everything. The import goes through your library, collection by collection, showing you what was recognized before writing anything.
landing_import_missing_lead: Your service isn't listed? You can request it
landing_import_done_tvtime_note: from an export made before it shut down
landing_name_title: A loom, and a place things are kept.
landing_name_body1: Six different materials, one single fabric. That's what the app does: it takes things that have nothing in common — a twenty-two minute episode, a six-hundred page novel, eighty hours of game — and turns them into a readable story.
landing_name_body2: It's built by one person, published as open source, with no ads and no investor to pay back. Your export is complete and free, today and the day you decide to leave.
landing_name_loom_body: The weaving loom. The threads are your domains; the weft is your time; the fabric forms while you watch.
landing_name_keep_body: A castle's keep: the part held onto last. Your data lives there — exportable, deletable, never resold.
landing_final_body: Free, no ads, open source, built by one person. You can export or delete everything whenever you want — that's stated before you sign up, not after.
landing_footer_tagline: One library for everything you watch, play, read and listen to. Free, no ads, and the code is public.
landing_footer_signature: Built and hosted by one person. No investor, so nothing to sell.
